name: LightGBM classifier
description: A classical model (LightGBM): gradient-boosted trees, grown leaf by leaf, classify rows of 20 numeric features and give class probabilities. Up to 1,000 trees with a learning rate of 0.05; early stopping on the validation rows keeps the best number of them. Each tree sees 80 % of the rows and of the features, and balanced class weights help with rare classes. A favourite of tabular competitions.
